key.name: default-sound
key.description: Bundled sound id played for notifications without a per-app rule, 'custom' for a custom file, or 'mute' for silence.

key.name: default-custom-file
key.description: Absolute path or file:// URI used when default-sound is 'custom'.

key.name: app-rules
key.description: JSON object mapping an app identifier (desktop file id, e.g. "org.gnome.Nautilus.desktop") to {"sound": id|"custom"|"mute", "file": path}. Missing or invalid entries fall back to the default sound.

key.name: seen-apps
key.description: JSON object mapping an app identifier to its display name, recorded when a notification is observed. Used to list apps in preferences.

key.name: rate-limit-ms
key.description: Minimum milliseconds between two played sounds. Extra notifications inside the window stay silent.

key.name: respect-dnd
key.description: When true, no sound is played while Do Not Disturb is on (org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners is false).

key.name: play-with-hint
key.description: When false, Appchime stays silent for notifications that already carry their own sound hint, so the sound is not doubled. When true, the Appchime sound plays as well.

key.name: debug
key.description: When true, Appchime logs resolved app identifiers and playback decisions to the journal. Useful for finding an app's identifier.

key.name: ignore-patterns
key.description: Case-insensitive substrings: a notification stays silent when its app identifier or display name contains any of them. Example: suspend.
